mock.region_sales: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' GROUP BY region
mock.customer_level: SELECT c.customer_level, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已支付' GROUP BY c.customer_level
mock.target_comparison: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS sales, MAX(t.target_amount) AS target FROM orders_current o JOIN sales_targets t ON o.region = t.region WHERE o.status = '已支付' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-09-01' AND t.target_month = '2026-08' GROUP BY o.region
mock.date_range: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-08-16' GROUP BY region
mock.clarify_orders: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' GROUP BY region
metric.paid_vs_list: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region
metric.list_amount: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(order_amount), 2) AS original_amount FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region
time.single_day: SELECT ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-15' AND order_date < DATE '2026-08-16'
time.history_july: SELECT ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_history WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
join.customer_orders: SELECT c.customer_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已支付' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level
grain.unique_customers: SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region
time.july_august: SELECT '2026-07' AS month, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_history WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-08-01' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-08' AS month, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
